Given the identical name, close coordinate proximity, and consecutive way numbering, this session treats that second row as very likely a duplicate OpenStreetMap recording of this same building rather than a second distinct facility, and records that row as duplicate_of this row rather than deleting it, consistent with this registry no delete policy. This row, the lower numbered of the pair, is treated as the primary record carrying the operator published figures.
